theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the challenger (rank 2, score 1.11) and passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) — the only validated leg. It is not crowded (crowding_z=0.2), so it avoids the reflexivity concern weighing on the leader. However, durability_bar (0.48) and breadth (0.267) are materially weaker than Oil & Gas, and Hurst is mixed, so this is a qualified positive on trend-discipline, not a momentum call.
evidence: eligible=true via absolute-trend gate (validated risk-control leg)

durability_bar=0.48, breadth=0.267 — weaker cohesion than leader

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks sits mid-board (rank 5, score 0.423) with a positive but modest score and passes the trend gate (eligible=true). Its Hurst tag is 'trend' and durability_bar (0.59) is respectable, but breadth is very low (0.143) and score is a full unit below the leaders — nothing in the detector supports adding exposure here relative to the two energy/metals leaders. Underweight expresses relative unattractiveness, not a fade or short.
